name: Simplicity Plan
description: One flat price per line no matter how many lines you have. Data slows to 4 Mbps only after 500GB in a month, and you get 10GB of hotspot, satellite texting and 3% back in Verizon Dollars.
international: Calls to Mexico & Canada; talk, text & data in Mexico & Canada; texts to 200+ countries
terms: $30/line when you switch from another carrier ($15/mo switch discount). Data slows to 4 Mbps after 500GB.

deals.title: $30/line when you switch
deals.details: A $15/mo per-line discount when you bring your number from another carrier, so each line costs $30/mo with AutoPay.
